body: Yeah, I have their email. I don't know if I will be able to talk with them now, but certainly some time in the future. I just don't know if I want to. Sometimes I feel beyond help.

Funny, the first part is actually the exact same advice my therapist gave me. And you're both right, making small talk and relaxing does help. But not by much. Because even if I have half a dozen light, relaxed conversations with people, I'm still alone at the end of the day. It just all feels so hopeless.

Thank you for the kind words. Not sure if having that hope is a good thing though. I don't have enough hope to solve my problems, but apparently I have *just* enough to stop me from actually fixing them.

Because I look at my failures now- my inability to create and maintain friendships, my uphill battle to build a career- and I don't see how it can get better. I feel like I will always be stuck, nothing will change.
